about: Lines the librarian has read and checked by hand. A path with a line replaces the tool's line; a path with null confirms the tool's line. Wake records and night-log snapshots are described from the record's own fields (kind, outcome, the work step; the counts of each list); the librarian checked the rule against records in full by sample. Letters (requests) are described from their headers: kind, sender, recipient, subject. index/tools/build_index.py marks these rows read_by librarian.
